note: One home for film v5's beat map (v4 keeps video/beats.json): DEMO_VERSION=v5 python3 video/review/build_review.py OUT_DIR writes video/beat_map_v5.md. Times are estimates until the TTS files exist. 'say' is the narrator unless a line starts with 'Coach:'. 'screen' describes everything visible. Words on screen stay at 5 or fewer per screen; eyebrows, test conditions and the How it works IN/OUT labels are evidence and don't count (design_guidelines_v5.md). The comparison is the Gemini Live API on the same footage and recipe; every Gemini line is real, from the paid-tier runs results/gemini_live_*_paid.json. The footage is prerecorded: no line implies the learner heard a coach.

beats.label: The hook
beats.say: Ever thought of having a coaching chef in your house, teaching you to cook?
beats.screen: The learner's head-camera view as a meal begins: ingredients come out of the fridge, then the onion goes onto the chopping board. Over the footage, centred white text: "Your own coaching chef?", with "coaching chef" in italic serif. Nothing else on screen.
beats.sound: The music starts with the cooking: Bushwick Tarantella (Kevin MacLeod, CC BY 4.0), under the narration.

beats.label: The catch
beats.say: We try Gemini Live with this recipe. We give it our learner's video too. But you'll need to constantly ask questions to get the coaching step.
beats.screen: The learner keeps cutting the onion, full screen, dimmed. Over it, white italic serif, the face of "coaching chef" in the hook, a line "The Recipe" above a numbered list: 1. Crack and whisk the eggs 2. Oil and heat the pan 3. Sauté onions and chillies 4. Pour in the eggs 5. Fold and stir 6. Off the heat, season 7. Plate with cottage cheese. It stays 2 s after the sentence ends, so it can be read. Then the dim lifts. On the last sentence a centred white line appears, the narrator's, not a coach card: "Keep asking." A small chip top-right, from the second sentence: GEMINI LIVE API · SAME VIDEO, SAME RECIPE.

beats.label: Chapter 1 · Gemini Live
beats.say: So we asked, every ten seconds, and it answers well. Coach: Keep chopping the red onion. Spray olive oil into your skillet. Whisk the eggs.
beats.screen: On a pale card, a grey numbered square "1" and the title "Gemini Live" for one second. Then three hard cuts, each with a white card whose grey eyebrow gives the time, plus a small chip "asked every 10 s" for the whole beat. 2:10, the onion under the knife: "Keep chopping the red onion." 4:30, the learner picks up the oil spray and sprays the pan: "Spray olive oil into your skillet." 5:20, an egg cracking into the bowl: "Whisk the eggs."
beats.sound: Pop on each card. The lines use Gemini's own recorded voice if the paid-tier rerun says the same words, the coach voice otherwise.

beats.label: Not one mention
beats.say: But for over three minutes, while the onion gets done, twenty-three answers, and not one mentions the eggs, the first step in the recipe.
beats.screen: The onion being chopped, full screen. Grey eyebrow GEMINI LIVE · 1:30–5:10. A big counter rolls to "23 answers" while it is spoken, then a second line lands beneath it: "Eggs: 0".
beats.sound: A soft tick as the counter rolls.

beats.label: Again and again
beats.say: And when a step has to wait, it just says it again. Pour the eggs. Twenty times in three minutes.
beats.screen: Three hard cuts: 9:00 the plate on the scale, 9:36 the onions being stirred, 10:06 oil going onto the cottage cheese. The same card stays top-left, eyebrow GEMINI LIVE · 8:30–11:40, "Pour the eggs." The counter beside it rolls from "×1" to a red "×20". It is the only red in the film.
beats.sound: A soft tick on each count.

beats.label: The turn
beats.say: So we designed an entire system around the chef.
beats.screen: The whole frame becomes solid memory green. Centred white text: "We designed a system.", with "system" in italic serif. A slow push-in.
beats.sound: The music drops out for this beat.

beats.label: Chapter 2 · With our system
beats.say: Start wherever you like. Our learner gets the plate ready first, and the chef goes along: fine, do it in parallel. Then the onion: keep going.
beats.screen: A green numbered square "2" and the title "With our system" for one second. Then the demo page's video: the learner on the left, the page's panel on the right (world model, coach, d1). The learner turns from the sink to the cottage-cheese plate; at 0:39 the coach's answer reaches the panel and a green card lands top-left, eyebrow OUR SYSTEM · 0:39, "Plate first? Fine." The coach's reply lifts out of the panel and grows to the centre, its line "fine to do in parallel" marked in green, holds for 2 s, then drops back. Hard cut to the onion being chopped (1:54); card "Keep going.", eyebrow OUR SYSTEM · 1:45, while the panel still shows that answer. When the world model's "peel onion" turns out right, the picture freezes for a second so its tick stays 2 s.
beats.sound: The music returns; pop on each card.

beats.label: It keeps track
beats.say: It keeps track: every action it sees is written down against a recipe step, so it always knows what has started and what is left.
beats.screen: A row of seven round step icons appears along the bottom, all grey outlines. Four two-second shots follow (the plate, the onion, the pan, the eggs), and with each one its icon fills green and shows the moment it was first seen: 0:13, 1:50, 4:36, 5:13.
beats.sound: A light tick on each fill.

beats.label: Only when it's needed
beats.say: It only speaks up when something is needed. The eggs still aren't cracked, so it brings them up, without being asked. Then Liquid AI's d1 decision model lines up the next moves. Open the carton. Take an egg. Crack it. Those are the next three things our learner does.
beats.screen: The demo page's video, footage left, model panel right. The learner is at the phone; at 4:53 the coach's answer reaches the panel and a green card lands top-left, eyebrow OUR SYSTEM · 4:53, "Back to the eggs." The coach's reply lifts out of the panel and grows to the centre, its line "back to cracking and whisking the eggs" marked in green, holds for 2.5 s, then drops back. Under the card, the step row (2, 3 and 7 on, as the memory has them). Hard cut to 5:10: d1's top three in the panel are open package, break egg and take egg; the learner opens the carton, takes an egg and cracks it, and each of d1's rows gets a green tick as its move happens, on the words "open", "take", "crack"; the picture freezes half a second on each tick. A small LIQUID AI d1 label sits by the panel's decision-model header. The world model's rows get a tick whenever its prediction comes true (break egg, put shell). Step 1 fills as the memory marks it, at 5:16.
beats.sound: Pop for the card, a whoosh as the reply lifts and drops, a soft tick on each green tick and on the fill.

beats.label: Another dish
beats.say: On a bacon and egg sandwich, it suggests shredding the cheese while the eggs cook, and reminds you to season the eggs before you build the sandwich. Asked every ten seconds, Gemini Live gets to the seasoning later.
beats.screen: The demo page's video of the Bacon & Egg run, footage left, model panel right. 6:45: the learner readies the baguette and cuts it (6:49) while the coach's 6:17 answer is on the panel; green card "Shred cheese meanwhile." (eyebrow OUR SYSTEM · 6:17) and the reply lifts to the centre, its line "shredding the cheddar cheese while the eggs and bacon continue cooking" marked. The world model's "cut bread" and d1's "cut bread (step 6)" get green ticks as the cutting happens. Hard cut to 7:01, the next answer arrives; card "Season the eggs first." Hard cut to 9:10: the eggs and bacon on the stove, seasoning not yet done. A white card, grey eyebrow GEMINI LIVE · 9:10, "Season the eggs." Hard cut to 9:21: the learner salts the eggs; the world model's "pour salt" and d1's "take salt" get their ticks.
beats.sound: Pops for the cards, a whoosh for the reply, soft ticks on the green ticks.

beats.label: Chapter 3 · How it works
beats.say: Here's the whole system. Meta's V-JEPA 2 world model takes in the last few seconds of video, and gives back the three likeliest next actions. The memory takes in those actions, and records each step's status, when it was seen, and what needs it. Muse Glimmer, the coach, takes in the recipe, the memory and the recent actions, and says where you are, what's next, and which step not to forget. And Liquid AI's d1 takes in the coach's advice, the predictions and the checklist, and picks one next move, every second.
beats.screen: A numbered square "3" and "How it works". On pale green paper, white cards appear one at a time, joined by dashed arrows: Video, V-JEPA 2, Memory, Muse Glimmer, Liquid AI d1, Next move. The card being named lights up green. Under the row, one strip for that card, with mono labels: IN and OUT. V-JEPA 2: IN "Last few seconds of video", OUT "Top 3 next actions". Memory: IN "Actions seen, with times", OUT "Status, when seen, what needs it". Muse Glimmer: IN "Recipe, memory, recent actions", OUT "Where you are, what's next, what not to forget". Liquid AI d1: IN "Advice, predictions, checklist", OUT "One next move, every second". The kitchen keeps playing in a small rounded square, bottom-right.
beats.sound: A soft tick as each card lands.

beats.label: One video, six steps
beats.say: We used one video, a bacon and egg sandwich. It has six steps: cook the bacon, mix the eggs, cook them, shred the cheese, season, and build the sandwich. Not asked, Gemini Live reminds you of none of them ahead of time. Ours reminds you of all but the last. It still misses what the camera can't see, and that's what we're working on next.
beats.screen: On paper, the eyebrow ONE VIDEO · BACON AND EGG SANDWICH, with that video playing in a small rounded square, bottom-right. Six rows land as each step is named: Cook the bacon, Mix the eggs, Cook the eggs, Shred the cheese, Season the eggs, Build the sandwich. A header row: REMINDED AHEAD?, Gemini Live · not asked, Our system. On "none", a grey dash lands in each Gemini Live row. On "Ours", a green tick lands in the first five Our system rows, and a grey dash in the sixth. It holds while the limit is said.

beats.label: The close
beats.say: Your own coaching chef, designed as a whole system.
beats.screen: The finished plate being seasoned, dimmed. White text: "Your own coaching chef.", with "coaching chef" in italic serif, echoing the opening. Then a paper card with the project name and the credits: built with Meta V-JEPA 2, Muse Glimmer and Liquid AI d1; footage HD-EPIC, University of Bristol, CC BY-NC 4.0; music "Bushwick Tarantella" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0. A small line is added to the credits: "Gemini Live API (gemini-3.8-live), tested <date>. Same footage and recipe, one frame every 2 s, asked every 10 s. Not the Gemini app."
